response.description:
As
organizations integrate external AI providers into production applications,
platform teams need consistent ways to secure, govern,
and observe model interactions across providers. Without centralized
controls and telemetry, managing compliance, troubleshooting issues, and
monitoring usage becomes increasingly difficult.  With
this update, Azure API Management extends AI gateway capabilities to
Anthropic and Google Vertex AI models, enabling organizations to apply runtime
policies, security controls, and observability across external model
endpoints.  This
allows teams to:  
 Apply runtime governance and
     security policies, such as content safety, token limits, or semantic
     caching, for Anthropic and Vertex AI models  
 Collect logs, traces, and
     metrics for Anthropic and Vertex AI model traffic   By
extending policy enforcement and observability to Anthropic and Vertex
AI models, Azure API Management helps
organizations operate multi-model AI environments with stronger
consistency, security, and enterprise control. Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure API Management now supports AI gateway capabilities for Anthropic and Vertex AI models.
